description: Fonzi connects engineers with AI startups and high-growth tech companies. Fonzi Talent brings your Fonzi account to ChatGPT so you can check your current status and next steps, explore hiring Companies, and review Interview Requests with the role, base salary, and response deadline upfront. Ask for more details about a Company or request, then accept or decline an Interview Request after confirming your decision. You can also start a resume upload and manage whether your conversation messages are shared with Fonzi for profile improvement. Conversation sharing is optional and can be turned off. The app acts through your signed-in Fonzi account and is free for engineers.

defaultPrompt: What’s next for me on Fonzi?
Do I have any Interview Requests waiting?
Which fintech companies are hiring on Fonzi?
